newsitem.title: CHINA: China fiscal revenue up 29.3 pct in first quarter.
newsitem.headline: China fiscal revenue up 29.3 pct in first quarter.

text.p: China's fiscal revenue in the first quarter increased by 29.3 percent and expenditures rose by 18.3 percent compared with the same year-ago period, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.

Consumption and value-added tax income rose by 20.1 percent, business tax income was up by 13.3 percent and personal income tax income increased by 45.5 percent compared with the same period a year ago, it said.
